bio_am: Կեսարիոյ Տէրէվէնք գիւղացի հայդուկապետ, ինկաւ Բասենի կռիւներուն մէջ՝ 1903 Սեպտեմբեր 17-ին։
bio_en: Barsegh Tiriakian, known as Khan, was born in 1863 in Derevenk, a Turkish-speaking Armenian village near Kayseri, one of the 'linguistically estranged' Armenians whom the revolution reunited with the nation. He became a noted ARF haiduk leader, famous for his fight at Khastur in 1899, where his band broke out under heavy fire to nearby hills, losing four of its ten-leaders. In September 1903 he led a large band across the Russo-Ottoman border into Basen. On 17 September 1903, firing his last cartridge, he fell with his comrades, and a folk song still sings of 'brave Khan's band'.
notes: Compiled from the archive review, 2026-10-12. Confidence: high. Text from S. Vratsian, 'Yushapatum'. See also #627 (Khastur fight).
